speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your headache in detail: where does it hurt, what does it feel like, and has it changed over the last three weeks? Have you noticed any specific visual changes, such as blurriness, double vision, or loss of vision in one or both eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intracranial meningioma.

I have noted your age and the three-week history of worsening headache and vision changes. Given the lack of systemic symptoms like fever or weight loss, this points toward a localized structural issue. I will now request imaging to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with contrast.
